title: Distributed Multimedia Systems: Main Exam, 20 December 2019
instructions: ANSWER QUESTION ONE AND ANY OTHER TWO. USE ILLUSTRATIONS WHERE NECESSARY. THE LAST PAGE OF THE ORIGINAL SCAN IS MISSING, SO QUESTIONS MARKED [PREDICTED] WERE WRITTEN TO COMPLETE THE PAPER AND ARE NOT FROM THE PRINTED PAPER.
